capabilities: Synchronize vaults across devices through a self-hosted server
Maintain per-file version history with diff and restore
Resolve concurrent edits with three-way merge and conflict files
Provide read-only Git clone access and a built-in MCP server
extras: Requires deploying and operating a self-hosted PKV Sync server; no telemetry. The server administrator can read vault content. The README is a release mirror and points to separate user and admin manuals.
problem: Obsidian users who want multi-device vault sync and versioned backup without a third-party service must otherwise combine separate sync and backup tools.

relations.evidence: Git is the source of truth: every change is a commit

summary: Self-hosted Git-backed synchronization plugin for Obsidian vaults with version history, conflict resolution, and MCP access.
